description: Defines the LeftPosition struct representing the left position in a shape within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Shapes namespace, including constructors, properties, and methods for handling shape positioning.

classes.name: LeftPosition
classes.description: Represents the left position in a shape, implementing INullableValue, with implicit conversions and serialization support.

methods.name: SetFromEnum
methods.description: Sets shape position enum and resets position.

methods.name: SetFromUnit
methods.description: Sets the Position from a Unit.

methods.name: INullableValue.SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the position from an object, handling ShapePosition, string, or Unit.

methods.name: INullableValue.GetValue
methods.description: Gets the value of the position, either ShapePosition or Unit.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create a LeftPosition, interpreting as Unit or ShapePosition.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Converts LeftPosition into DDL via serializer.
